links.outcome: LLM preoperative anaesthetic plan conformity to French guidelines, expert-scored 0-4 across 12 domains
links.effect: ChatGPT highest conformity, 98% completeness, highest median in 7 of 12 domains; Dougall GPT moderate; Mistral lowest conformity and highest proportion of unsafe or potentially unsafe outputs (scores ≤2).
links.quote: Dougall GPT performed moderately, whereas Mistral LeChat showed lower conformity and the highest proportion of unsafe or potentially unsafe outputs (scores ≤2).

screen.reason: Evaluates three LLMs (ChatGPT, Mistral, Dougall GPT) on 100 synthetic preoperative anaesthetic cases compared to expert reference plans, focusing on guideline adherence and safety, without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
